argv:
set -eu
npm ci --offline --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
export CI=true NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1
printf 'EXEC_METADATA
'
ls -l node_modules/.bin/eslint node_modules/.bin/next node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js node_modules/next/dist/bin/next
cat /proc/mounts | grep ' /tmp '
set +e
npm run build
code=$?
set -e
echo "BUILD_EXIT:$code"
du -sk /tmp/work
df -k /tmp
exit "$code"
scope: local exact production build image boundary probe; no full/native acceptance
